title: Darkshield
tagline: I design enterprise integrations for a living and run an AI-agent-powered homelab for fun. This is where I write down what worked and what broke.
author: Alok Chatterji

seriesIntro.AI-Led Homelab: EDITH is what I call my AI-run homelab project, and also the orchestrating agent at its centre. This series is how I build and run it with AI doing the hands-on work while I keep the calls that cannot be undone. New here? Start at part 1.
seriesIntro.Homelab: The homelab posts, in the order I wrote them: what I run at home, why, and what I learned running it.
